items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: He played with a lot of bands around here like Chris Kelly, Charlie Love.

ctx.x: He's back quite a way. Did anybody else in your family play?

Yeah, I had several cuts and I had James Cobet used to play. He played with a lot of bands around here like Chris Kelly, Charlie Love. I think they made the first trip to Mexico, old Mexico. Oh, yeah. Him, Charlie Love, James Cobet, little dead on banjo. I just remember the lineup. What did he play?
